title: Program
description: An ongoing or defined government activity, administered by a government organization to achieve a public purpose, such as road maintenance or adult mental health. A program is persistent: it appears in many budgets across many fiscal years while a `BudgetLine` belongs to one. It is not an organization, not a bounded `Project` that ends, and not a `GovernmentService` a person can apply for. schema.org has no equivalent, so `gs:Program` is minted.

@id.description: This program's own stable identifier. It does not change from one fiscal year to the next.

alternateName.description: Other names the program is known by.

description.description: What the program does and who it is for.

identifier.description: Scheme-qualified identifiers, such as the program code in a budget system. A code is only unique within that system.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
